title: Exception Prevention & Bounds Checking Simulator
description: Visualizing how defensive conditional guards intercept invalid index accesses before Python raises an unhandled IndexError exception.
codeLines: else: print('Invalid index: bounds check prevented crash')

steps.explanation: Initialize list numbers with 3 elements: [10, 20, 30]. Valid indexes are 0, 1, and 2.
Target index is set to 5 (which is outside the list bounds).
Evaluating condition: 0 <= 5 < 3. 5 is not less than 3, so is_valid evaluates to False.
Condition is False. The direct access numbers[5] is safely skipped, avoiding an IndexError.
The else branch executes cleanly, notifying the user without halting the program.
steps.output: Invalid index: bounds check prevented crash
